title: Midnight Sun - Viking way ATV Adventure with transfer from Reykjavik
excerpt: From May to August - Experience the Midnight Sun in a small group ATV Quad tour  - Use promo code "MOL" for 10% off the price for "Meet On Location" if you have a car and meet us on location.
description:
Midnight Sun ATV Safari

Experience the Magic of the Bright Icelandic Night!

Imagine driving a powerful ATV into the mountains at midnight, yet it’s almost as bright as day. Join us for this thrilling evening safari for a truly unforgettable experience.

As we reach our viewpoint, you will be struck by the unparalleled peace and tranquility of the Icelandic countryside. Far from the city noise, all you might hear is the sound of your own breath. The views are breathtaking, offering a clear panorama over Reykjavík, the charming town of Mosfellsbær, and the volcanic Reykjanes peninsula with its distant, dormant volcanoes. If the horizon is clear, you can even spot the majestic steam rising from geothermal fields and the iconic Snæfellsjökull glacier across the bay.

A Celebration of Summer Nature

This tour is a unique opportunity to experience Iceland's summer nature up close. Ask your expert guide about the flora, from the vibrant purple Alaska Lupin that covers the fields to the powerful Angelica Archangelica, a healing plant steeped in history. As we ride, listen for the beautiful breeding song of the local birds, filling the bright night with music.

This is more than just an ATV tour; it’s a rare moment of connection with nature under the everlasting light of the midnight sun.

Important Details & Logistics

  • Group Size: To ensure a personal experience, we limit group sizes to a maximum of 8 people (or up to 16 by special request).
  • Booking Early: Due to its popularity, we highly recommend booking this tour early during your stay in Iceland to secure your spot.

Pickup & Meeting Point: We offer free pickup from most hotels in the greater Reykjavík area. Please note: Reykjavík city has designated special "Tourist Bus Stops" in the downtown area, as direct pickups are prohibited there. Your nearest bus stop is usually just a short walk away. You can find the closest stop to you at www.busstop.is.

Alternatively, you are welcome to meet us directly at our basecamp, which is conveniently located only 20 minutes from downtown Reykjavík.

Pricing & Riding Options:

  • Prices are per person.
  • Shared Ride: Each ATV seats two people (driver and passenger). You must have two participants in your booking to select this option.
  • Solo Ride: Single riders, or groups with an odd number of people (e.g., 3, 5, 7), must book at least one Solo Ride.

Requirements:

  • Drivers: All drivers must possess and present a fully valid driving license.
  • Passengers: Minimum age for a passenger is 6 years old. Children up to 17 years old pay the child rate.
